_description: Single source of truth for all FIPS/microfips device identity keys.
_usage: See GitHub issue #64. MCU keys are deterministic (generator * N). FIPS host keys are persistent on disk.
_secret_note: MCU secrets are NOT secure — they are deterministic test keys. Secure key storage is tracked in #64.

vps.label: VPS FIPS (orangeclaw)
vps.source: /etc/fips/fips.key on VPS, pubkey in crates/microfips-core/src/identity.rs VPS_PEER_PUB

linux.label: Linux FIPS (dev workstation)
linux.comment: Persistent key generated by FIPS on first run. Refreshed 2026-08-18 from /etc/fips/fips.pub (previous recorded key was stale).

mac.label: Mac FIPS
mac.comment: Persistent key on Mac FIPS instance

esp32s3b.label: ESP32-S3 Walter #2 (MAC cc:8d:a2:2c:94:08)
esp32s3b.comment: secp256k1 generator * 7. Second Walter board; build with DEVICE_NSEC_HEX_esp32s3 override to use it alongside the first (generator * 5).
esp32s3b.source: keys.json only (env override at build time)

lab-daemon.label: FIPS daemon on lab workstation (UDP :21213, mDNS)
lab-daemon.comment: secp256k1 generator * 8. Assigned 2026-08-29 for the PR #156 lab bench (see AGENTS.md).
lab-daemon.source: keys.json (deterministic lab bench identity; env-override at build time)
